text.EN: Nice drop. Did it touch you?
text.TL: Magandang bagsak. Nahawakan ka ba no'n?

text.EN: Great hit. Are you feeling alright?
text.TL: Magandang hampas. Maayos ba pakiramdam mo?

text.EN: You got it! Take a quick breath.
text.TL: Nakuha mo! Huminga ka muna sandali.

text.EN: Well done. You hurt at all?
Clean take down. You holding up?
text.TL: Malinis na pagpabagsak. Nakakayanan mo ba?

text.EN: Good work. I'm right here with you.
text.TL: Magandang gawa. Nandito lang ako kasama mo.

text.EN: Got him! You safe on your side?
text.TL: Naitumba mo! Ligtas ka riyan sa tabi mo?

text.EN: Nice work putting that down. You alright?
text.TL: Magaling ang pagpapabagsak no'n. Ayos ka lang?

text.EN: Dropped it cleanly. Tell me if you need help.
text.TL: Bumagsak nang maayos. Sabihin mo kung kailangan mo ng tulong.
